data.narrative:
QuantumDiamonds is a Seed-stage quantum computing company founded by Kevin Berghoff and Fleming Bruckmaier that has raised €7M in seed funding plus €152M in facility commitments. The quantum computing sector comp universe consists of 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using the €7M seed raise as a base valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage financing yields an implied valuation of €18M. The Peer-Median method could not be applied due to insufficient comparable datapoints—while 8 private peers exist in the quantum computing sector, none of the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier filters yielded three or more usable comparables. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable bias.

The triangulated valuation range supported by available methods is €15M (low), €18M (median), to €20M (high). This narrow range reflects dependence on a single method rather than robust cross-validation. Key uncertainties include the eventual deployment utility of the facility commitment, the company's progress toward commercial traction, and the stability of valuation multiples within an early-stage, capital-intensive sector where comparable M&A and financing data remain sparse.
